ask: Among pickup-dropoff LocationID pairs in the clean set with at least 500 trips, which pair has the highest mean total_amount? Answer as PU-DO, e.g. 132-230.
sql:
SELECT pu || '-' || do_id FROM (
  SELECT "PULocationID" AS pu, "DOLocationID" AS do_id, count(*) AS n,
         avg(total_amount) AS fare,
         avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (tpep_dropoff_datetime - tpep_pickup_datetime)) / 60.0) AS mins,
         avg(trip_distance) AS miles,
         avg(tip_amount / nullif(fare_amount, 0)) AS tip_rate
  FROM t WHERE 
  fare_amount > 0 AND total_amount > 0 AND trip_distance > 0
  AND tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
  AND tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
  AND tpep_dropoff_datetime > tpep_pickup_datetime

  GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) >= 500
) ORDER BY fare DESC, pu, do_id LIMIT 1

  SELECT "PULocationID" AS pu, "DOLocationID" AS do_id, count(*) AS n,
         avg(total_amount) AS fare,
         avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (tpep_dropoff_datetime - tpep_pickup_datetime)) / 60.0) AS mins,
         avg(trip_distance) AS miles,
         avg(tip_amount / nullif(fare_amount, 0)) AS tip_rate
  FROM t WHERE 
  fare_amount > 0 AND total_amount > 0 AND trip_distance > 0
  AND tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
  AND tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
  AND tpep_dropoff_datetime > tpep_pickup_datetime

  GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) >= 500
) WHERE fare > 50

ask: Among pairs with at least 500 clean-set trips, what is the mean of their mean fares per mile? Two decimals.
sql:
SELECT round(avg(fare / miles), 2) FROM (
  SELECT "PULocationID" AS pu, "DOLocationID" AS do_id, count(*) AS n,
         avg(total_amount) AS fare,
         avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (tpep_dropoff_datetime - tpep_pickup_datetime)) / 60.0) AS mins,
         avg(trip_distance) AS miles,
         avg(tip_amount / nullif(fare_amount, 0)) AS tip_rate
  FROM t WHERE 
  fare_amount > 0 AND total_amount > 0 AND trip_distance > 0
  AND tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
  AND tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
  AND tpep_dropoff_datetime > tpep_pickup_datetime

  GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) >= 500
)

ask: Taking the ten pairs with the most clean-set trips, which of those ten has the highest mean total_amount? Answer as PU-DO.
sql:
SELECT pu || '-' || do_id FROM (SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT "PULocationID" AS pu, "DOLocationID" AS do_id, count(*) AS n,
         avg(total_amount) AS fare,
         avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (tpep_dropoff_datetime - tpep_pickup_datetime)) / 60.0) AS mins,
         avg(trip_distance) AS miles,
         avg(tip_amount / nullif(fare_amount, 0)) AS tip_rate
  FROM t WHERE 
  fare_amount > 0 AND total_amount > 0 AND trip_distance > 0
  AND tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
  AND tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
  AND tpep_dropoff_datetime > tpep_pickup_datetime

  GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) >= 500
) ORDER BY n DESC, pu, do_id LIMIT 10) ORDER BY fare DESC, pu, do_id LIMIT 1
